title: Substream quarantine and commit protocol for safe interleaved prefill orchestration
creator: Amelia Chen
description: Background: We continue to see nondeterministic failures during multi-stream decode when concurrent prefill/capture windows overlap and kernel selection differs across streams (different sequence lengths or quant/occupancy heuristics). Root cause analysis points to two correlated issues: (1) cross-stream visibility of ephemeral KV/prefill state during a partial capture commit, and (2) differing kernel bindings leading to replay divergence when a captured graph is reused across slightly different execution contexts. Impact: transient correctness violations (soft corruptions), rare API-level token mismatches, and customer-facing flakiness for production workloads that use low-latency multi-stream decode. Goal: introduce a lightweight runtime mechanism to isolate (quarantine) prefill state per logical substream until a safe commit point is reached, plus a deterministic commit/rollback protocol and a fast deterministic fallback path that preserves throughput for common cases.
acceptance_criteria: No observed token mismatch regressions in our multi-stream stress harness across 100k random interleavings within CI
Capture commit latency overhead <= 4% p95 for steady-state multi-stream workloads
Replay correctness verified across mixed-quant/sequence-length matrix used in production benchmarks
Feature gate + rollout plan exists so we can enable on dedicated clusters and run canary tests before global rollout
design_notes: Introduce 'substream epoch' scoped KV buffers that are visible only to the originating stream until commit

Commit protocol: substream produces a commit record containing tombstone + kernel-binding metadata; coordinator validates kernel compatibility and attaches epoch marker to GPU graph before making it globally visible

Rollback: if commit validation fails (kernel mismatch or overlapping epoch incompatible), the coordinator triggers a fast rollback that: drops ephemeral KV, invalidates candidate graph, and routes affected requests to single-stream replay path
Fallback heuristics: for short sequences (<8 tokens) prefer optimistic commit; for heterogeneous hardware or quant settings prefer conservative commit
Tradeoffs: quarantine increases memory pressure for high concurrency; mitigation includes LRU eviction of oldest quarantined epochs and burst shedding to single-stream decode when memory high
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (spike): implement in-memory substream KV wrapper, add lightweight commit/validate handshakes (2 weeks)
Phase 2: wire kernel-binding metadata into capture metadata blob; add coordinator-side validator and fast rollback path (3 weeks)
Phase 3: integrate with graph cache eviction and add metrics/telemetry (2 weeks)
Phase 4: long-run optimizations: memory compaction for quarantined epochs and adaptive heuristic tuning (follow-up)
Owners: runtime (Ravi) for executor changes, scheduler (Sofia) for coordinator logic, infra (Diego) for test harness scaling
test_plan: Extend existing fuzz harness to inject interleaved prefill schedules and record token-by-token outputs across both optimistic and fallback paths
Add deterministic unit tests for kernel-binding validation logic (simulate quant/seq length variation)
Scale load test with mixed seq lengths and batch sizes on dedicated staging cluster and compare p99 latencies and correctness against baseline
Introduce canary job in console with synthetic traffic and alerting for token-mismatch rate > 0.01%
rollout: Feature flag behind runtime-1.24 gate; default off for hosted tenants
Canary: enable on dedicated clusters for 2 high-volume customers and monitor correctness + latency for 72 hours
Gradual: auto-enable for clusters with <60% GPU memory utilization and low heterogeneity; provide opt-out flag per-deployment
Rollback: feature flip off + invalidate any quarantined epochs and fallback to single-stream decode cache restoration
metrics: token_mismatch_rate: fraction of requests with token divergence compared to golden trace
quarantine_memory_bytes: total bytes held in quarantined epochs
commit_validation_failures: count and breakdown by reason (kernel_mismatch, overlap, OOM)
prefill_commit_latency_p95: time from prefill end to commit visibility
fallback_rate: fraction of captures that fall back to single-stream replay
